name: g2_binaries_isi
label: ISI at Palomar with ID230s: Capella and the catalog binaries, 900 and 1550 nm, a baseline per night from 5 m to 1 km
notes: Capella (56 mas, two 6-8 mas giants) gives fringes of period lambda/rho = 5.7 m at 1550 nm, smeared by the 1.65 m pupils, on the 5-100 m nights; the 1-3 mas binaries (beta Aur, Algol, Spica) need the 300-1000 m nights, and their g/i anchors are extrapolated to the near-IR by the blackbody SED (warning suppressed).
